mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.name, t.slug, t.create_time AS createTime, COUNT(DISTINCT at.article_id) AS articleCount FROM blog_tag t LEFT JOIN blog_article_tag at ON t.id = at.tag_id LEFT JOIN blog_article a ON at.article_id = a.id AND a.status = 'PUBLISHED' GROUP BY t.id ORDER BY articleCount DESC, t.id ASC
